title: Lines
note: Count the strokes. 一, 二, 三 stack the same line.

chars.tip: One line.
Two lines. Bottom one is a little longer.
Three lines. Middle one is shortest.
A plus sign. Ten.
Like 二 with a stick down the middle.

title: People
note: Look twins: 人 and 入. Then 人 grows into 大, 天, and 夫.

chars.tip: Two legs. The left stroke sits on top.
Going in. The right stroke sits on top.
A person with arms stretched wide.
大 with a little extra drop.
A line over 大. The sky above a person.
Like 天, but the middle stick pokes out the top.

title: Earth & up-down
note: Twins 土 and 士: which line is longer?

chars.tip: Bottom line is longer — the ground is wide.
Top line is longer — like a hat.
A short mark above the line.
A mark hanging under the line.

title: Trees
note: Start with 木. 未 and 末 look almost the same.

chars.tip: A tree with roots and branches.
Two trees.
Three trees. A whole forest.
A mark at the bottom of 木 — the roots.
Top bar is shorter. Not done growing.
Top bar is longer. Grown to the tip.
木 with a little droop on top. Grain plant.

title: Boxes
note: 口 is a mouth. 日 is tall. 曰 is wide. Compare them in a row.

chars.tip: An open square. A mouth.
Tall and skinny, like a window of sun.
Shorter and wider than 日. A mouth talking.
Like 日 with an extra shelf. An eye.
A square field with a plus inside.
日 with a little slash on top.
一 sitting on 白.
目 with a tiny extra mark. Point at yourself.

title: Animals
note: 十 hides inside 牛. 马 will show up again as a sound piece.

chars.tip: Like 十 with extra horns and a tail.
Horns on top.
This shape will later be a sound hint: ma.
A bird with a little eye.
Flames kicking up.

title: Mom sounds like horse
note: 女 means woman. 马 says the sound. Together: 妈. That is how most characters work!

chars.tip: The meaning piece for girl / woman / mom.
Here 马 is a SOUND piece, not a horse-mom.
女 (meaning) + 马 (sound) = mā, mom.
口 (mouth) + 马 (sound). Turns a sentence into a question.

title: The 青 family
note: 青 sounds like qing. Add water, heart, sun, or speech and the meaning changes.

chars.tip: Splashy water.
A little person with arms down.
小 with an extra slash. Not many.
The sound piece for this whole family.
Water + 青. Clear water.
Heart + 青. A feeling.
Speech + 青. Please / invite.
Sun + 青. A sunny day.

title: Hands & friends
note: 又 is a hand. Two of them make 友, friend.

chars.tip: Fingers on a palm.
An old picture of a right hand.
Two hands. Friends.
The everyday no / not word.
